target.title: test(qa): record QA coverage and #99310 adoption baseline
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QA coverage ownership, scenario execution kinds, duplicate IDs, live blockers, runtime durations, Crabline bridge readiness, and merged #99310 adoption were not committed together as a stable baseline. Reviewers had to reconstruct the current state from multiple commands and code-defined catalogs.

Closes #99621.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one machine-readable baseline and one reviewer-facing summary using the existing QA coverage and scenario catalog. The artifacts record all 155 canonical scenarios and all 82 code-defined live transport scenarios, verify `@openclaw/crabline` `0.1.8` across seven public bridge adapters, identify helper-backed primary claims, audit duplicate IDs, and capture focused #99310 flow and test evidence.

The change adds no runtime behavior, transport schema, evidence writer, or duplicate-ID validator implementation.

## User Impact

No user-visible runtime behavior changes. QA maintainers can review scenario and coverage changes against a committed reference instead of rebuilding the inventory manually.

## Evidence

- Source revision `df1452799b28782ebfe273b4dcaf779cf34ced38` matched `origin/main` and contains #99310 merge commit `8604dbdc93fb8eea3db3891944e60ede6b0625f2`.
- `channel-message-flows` passed through QA Channel in 10.045s and Crabline Telegram in 11.381s.
- Focused #99310 tests: 9 files and 200 tests passed via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`.
- `@openclaw/crabline` `0.1.8`: Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Matrix, Signal, Mattermost, and Zalo all started and probed through `startOpenClawCrablineAdapter`.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwmn13d2ttf48fq8z555027v`: `docker-compose-setup`, `gateway-smoke`, `mcp-gateway-connect-startup-retry`, and `webchat-auto-tts` passed; Matrix fast passed 15/15 in 60.708s.
- Hosted live image generation passed 2/2 checks in 101.951s.
- Formatting, JSON/source-count consistency assertions, and secret-pattern scan passed.
- Codex autoreview found one incomplete live-catalog count; it was corrected from the coverage subset to the complete 82-scenario catalog, and the final review reported no accepted/actionable findings.

Discord, Slack, Telegram, and WhatsApp live channel executions were credential-blocked in this session; the baseline records that state rather than claiming passing live coverage.
